Theo the little mountain train puffed happily through the pine-covered valley as the afternoon sun gilded the tracks.
Tonight, Theo would carry a tiny music box to the hilltop chalet for its cozy evening gathering.
His friend Maren, a small mountain goat, waited by the station with the music box tucked in a soft blue cloth.
Theo stopped beside Maren, and together they settled the little music box safely into his open wagon.
With a cheerful toot, Theo rolled past snowy fir trees while Maren rode snugly in the wagon beside the box.
Little flakes drifted down as the mountain path curved gently between glowing cabin windows.
Maren listened to the hush of the snow, and Theo slowed his wheels to enjoy the peaceful evening.
At the hilltop chalet, warm golden lanterns shone, but Maren still carried the music box onto the sheltered porch.
The music box played a soft tinkling tune, and Theo listened from the track while the first stars appeared.
When the tune ended, Maren wrapped the music box again, and together the friends watched the snow settle over the rooftops.
Theo and Maren traveled slowly home beneath the lavender sky, with the music box snug in the wagon.
At the little valley station, Theo parked beside the wooden shed while Maren lifted the music box onto a dry shelf.
Maren curled into her straw-lined nook inside the shed, and Theo rested on his familiar siding just outside.
Moonlight silvered the snow as Maren closed her eyes and Theo's little headlamp dimmed to a gentle glow.
Beneath the quiet stars, Theo and Maren drifted peacefully to sleep while soft snow tucked their mountain home into silence.
